stories.detail: A run of 9 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Spot Fires

stories.detail: Back-to-back 3-pointers on holes 18 & 1

stories.title: Steady Eddie

stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 12 & 13 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups
